dataset_label: KisanSahay Scheme Rule Dataset v2.0 – 21 Maharashtra/Central Government Agricultural Schemes

schemes.source_document: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI
schemes.source_section: Section 3: Eligibility Criteria – Landowning farmer families

requirements.label: Land ownership (any cultivable land)
requirements.why_required: Scheme targets landowning farmer families; land record is mandatory proof.

requirements.label: Non-income-tax-payer
requirements.why_required: Income-tax payers are excluded per scheme guidelines.

benefit.description: Rs 6,000/year in 3 equal installments of Rs 2,000 via DBT

schemes.source_document: Maharashtra Government Resolution, Agriculture Dept., 2023
schemes.source_section: GR No. SANMAN-2023/CR-84/6A – Eligibility Criteria

requirements.label: Land ownership in Maharashtra
requirements.why_required: State scheme; farmer must own land registered in Maharashtra.

requirements.label: Non-income-tax-payer
requirements.why_required: Income-tax payers are excluded per state guidelines.

benefit.description: Rs 6,000/year in 3 equal installments (complements PM-KISAN for combined Rs 12,000/year)

schemes.scheme_name: PMFBY – Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
schemes.source_document: PMFBY Revised Operational Guidelines, MoAFW, 2020
schemes.source_section: Chapter 4: Premium Rates – Farmer share capped at 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi

requirements.label: Cultivable land holding
requirements.why_required: Must be a cultivating farmer to enroll.

benefit.description: Comprehensive crop loss coverage at Rs 1 token premium for small/marginal farmers

schemes.source_document: RBI/NABARD KCC Revised Scheme Guidelines, 2012 & 2018 Amendment
schemes.source_section: Para 3.1: Eligibility – Farmer with cultivable land; interest subvention up to Rs 3 lakh at 4% p.a.

requirements.label: Cultivable land (any holding)
requirements.why_required: KCC requires proof of cultivable land.

benefit.description: Short-term crop loan up to Rs 3 lakh at 4% p.a. with timely repayment interest subvention

schemes.scheme_name: Magel Tyala Shet Tale (Farm Pond Scheme)
schemes.source_document: Maharashtra MGNREGS + Agriculture Dept. GR, 2017
schemes.source_section: GR Krishi-2017/CR-142 – Farm pond subsidy up to Rs 50,000

requirements.label: Minimum 0.6 hectare land holding
requirements.why_required: Farm pond requires sufficient land area; minimum 0.6 ha mandated.

benefit.description: Subsidy up to Rs 50,000 for constructing a farm pond for water storage

schemes.source_document: Maharashtra Horticulture Dept., Bhausaheb Fundkar Scheme Guidelines, 2018
schemes.source_section: Section 2: 100% subsidy for orchard planting over 3 years

requirements.label: Land holding (minimum 0.2 hectare)
requirements.why_required: Orchard planting requires minimum land area.

benefit.description: 100% subsidy for fruit orchard planting over 3 years (mango, cashew, orange, pomegranate)

schemes.source_document: MNRE PM-KUSUM Scheme Guidelines, 2019; Component-B Standalone Solar Pumps
schemes.source_section: Para 4.2: Subsidy Structure – 90% subsidy for off-grid solar pumps (60% Central + 30% State)

requirements.label: Agricultural land
requirements.why_required: Solar pump must be installed on agricultural land.

benefit.description: Up to 90% subsidy on solar agricultural pump installation (5 HP or 7.5 HP pump)

schemes.scheme_name: Gopinath Munde Shetkari Apghat Vima Yojana
schemes.source_document: GR No. Krishi-2015/Pra.Kra.190/11A, Agriculture Dept., Maharashtra
schemes.source_section: Clause 4: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death; Rs 1 lakh for permanent disability

requirements.label: Registered farmer (any land holding)
requirements.why_required: Only registered landowning farmers are covered.

benefit.description: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death; Rs 1 lakh for permanent disability; Rs 50,000 for partial disability

schemes.scheme_name: Mahatma Jotirao Phule Karjmukti Yojana (Loan Waiver)
schemes.source_document: Maharashtra GR, Finance Dept., 2019 – Short-term crop loan waiver
schemes.source_section: Section 3: Waiver up to Rs 2 lakh for short-term crop loans outstanding as of 30-Sep-2019

requirements.label: Farmer with agricultural land
requirements.why_required: Scheme is for farmer loan relief only.

requirements.label: Annual income below Rs 1.5 lakh
requirements.why_required: Loan waiver targeted at low-income farmers.

benefit.description: Outstanding short-term crop loan waiver up to Rs 2 lakh

schemes.source_document: eNAM Scheme Document, SFAC, Ministry of Agriculture, 2016
schemes.source_section: Para 2: Any farmer can sell on eNAM platform through registered APMCs

requirements.label: Agricultural produce to sell
requirements.why_required: Must be a farmer with produce to register on eNAM.

benefit.description: Direct access to transparent electronic market for agricultural commodities

schemes.source_document: PoCRA Project Implementation Plan, 2018; Maharashtra Agriculture Dept.
schemes.source_section: Component 2: On-farm investments – 50%-75% subsidy on drip/sprinkler/shade nets

requirements.label: Land in PoCRA project districts
requirements.why_required: PoCRA covers 5,142 revenue circles in Vidarbha and Marathwada.

requirements.label: Small or marginal farmer (income below Rs 3 lakh)
requirements.why_required: Higher subsidy (75%) for small/marginal farmers.

benefit.description: 50% to 75% subsidy for drip irrigation, sprinkler systems, and shade nets

schemes.scheme_name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana
schemes.source_document: Maharashtra Social Justice Dept. GR – Dr. Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban, 2021
schemes.source_section: Section 2.1: Financial assistance for SC/ST farmers for water conservation and input support

requirements.label: SC/ST category
requirements.why_required: Scheme is exclusively for SC and ST farmers.

requirements.label: Agricultural land (up to 6 hectares)
requirements.why_required: Must be a farming family with land record.

benefit.description: Financial assistance up to Rs 2.5 lakh for water conservation, farm pond, bore well, and agricultural inputs

schemes.scheme_name: PKVY – Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (Organic Farming)
schemes.source_document: PKVY Scheme Guidelines, MoAFW, 2015; Revised 2020
schemes.source_section: Para 5: Rs 50,000/hectare/year for 3 years (Input cost Rs 31,000 + Value chain Rs 19,000)

requirements.label: Minimum 0.5 hectare cultivable land
requirements.why_required: Minimum land required for cluster-based organic farming certification.

benefit.description: Rs 50,000 per hectare per year for 3 years to promote organic farming and certification

schemes.source_document: AIF Scheme Guidelines, MoAFW, August 2020
schemes.source_section: Section 3: Interest subvention of 3% p.a. for post-harvest management infra financing

requirements.label: Agricultural land or farm-based enterprise
requirements.why_required: AIF requires proof of farming activity or agri-enterprise.

benefit.description: 3% interest subvention on loans up to Rs 2 crore for cold storage, warehouses, processing units

schemes.scheme_name: PMKSY – PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Micro Irrigation)
schemes.source_document: PMKSY-PDMC Guidelines, 2016; MIDH Implementing Agency
schemes.source_section: Para 6.1: 80% subsidy for marginal farmers (<1 ha); 70% for small farmers (1-2 ha)

requirements.label: Agricultural land (any size)
requirements.why_required: Micro-irrigation subsidy is land-area based.

benefit.description: 80% subsidy for marginal farmers (<1 ha); 70% for small farmers (1-2 ha) on drip/sprinkler installation

schemes.scheme_name: SMAM – Sub Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
schemes.source_document: SMAM Scheme Guidelines, 2014-15; MoAFW
schemes.source_section: Para 7: Subsidy on tractors – SC/ST/Women 50%; Others 40%; max Rs 1 lakh

requirements.label: Agricultural land holding
requirements.why_required: Mechanization subsidy is for active farmers with land.

requirements.label: Annual income below Rs 6 lakh
requirements.why_required: Priority to small and marginal farmers.

benefit.description: Subsidies up to Rs 1 lakh for tractors; 40-50% subsidy on other farm machinery

schemes.source_document: Soil Health Card Scheme, MoAFW, 2015
schemes.source_section: All farmers eligible; issued every 2 years with crop-wise fertilizer recommendation

requirements.label: Agricultural land (any size)
requirements.why_required: Soil testing is done on the farmer field.

benefit.description: Free soil testing and customized fertilizer/crop advisory card every 2 years

schemes.scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Krishi ani Anna Prakriya Yojana
schemes.source_document: Maharashtra Industry Dept. GR, Food Processing Policy 2022
schemes.source_section: Section 4: Grants for agri-food processing units; 25% capital subsidy up to Rs 25 lakh

requirements.label: Agricultural land or processing unit
requirements.why_required: Processing unit must be on/near agricultural land.

benefit.description: 25% capital subsidy up to Rs 25 lakh for agri-food processing unit setup

schemes.source_document: GoI Cabinet Approval, Nov 2023 – Namo Drone Didi Scheme for SHGs
schemes.source_section: 15,000 drones to SHG clusters; 80% subsidy; precision nutrient/pesticide application

requirements.label: Farm land for drone services
requirements.why_required: Drone services deployed on registered agricultural land.

benefit.description: Access to drones for precision nutrient and pesticide distribution; SHG members get priority

schemes.source_document: Maharashtra State Agriculture Dept. and NABARD, MoU 2022
schemes.source_section: Term loans and working capital at concessional rates for agro-processing enterprises

requirements.label: Agricultural land or agro-enterprise
requirements.why_required: Scheme targets farm-based enterprises.

requirements.label: Annual income below Rs 5 lakh
requirements.why_required: Scheme targets small agro-processors.

benefit.description: Term loans and working capital at concessional interest for agro-processing startups

schemes.source_document: Maharashtra Agriculture Dept. GR – CHC Custom Hiring Centre Policy, 2020
schemes.source_section: Section 3: Subsidized rental of heavy agri equipment via CHC network

requirements.label: Registered farmer with land
requirements.why_required: Rental services are for registered farmers with land records.

benefit.description: Subsidized rental of heavy agricultural equipment: combine harvesters, tractors, rotavators via CHC network
